attributes.title: 2027 LVMA Winter Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana VMA holds its 2027 Winter Meeting January 22 to 24, 2027 at the Hilton New Orleans Riverside. The winter meeting is the association's main CE event and includes an exhibit area.

Early-bird pricing ends after December 21, 2026. Pre-registration closes January 15, 2027, and on-site registration will also be available. Lecture notes are sent electronically to all registrants at no extra cost. Guest registration covers continental breakfasts, refreshment breaks and the auxiliary tour.

The event page does not list the fees or total CE hours. Check with the LVMA office before you register.
